basic_info.description: Welcome to this light-filled Central Sunset home, where modern comfort meets classic San Francisco charm. 1527 26th Avenue offers two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a flexible lower level with incredible potential. The main floor features a bright living room with a cozy fireplace, a spacious dining room, and a center patio that seamlessly connects to the kitchenperfect for morning coffee. Two sunlit bedrooms and elegantly finished bathrooms provide timeless appeal, while the lower level offers a versatile space, ample storage, and exciting expansion possibilities. The expansive backyard is a private retreat, ideal for relaxation or entertaining. Just two blocks from Irving Street's vibrant restaurants, cafs, and shops, and three blocks from Golden Gate Park, this home offers the best of city living with exceptional convenience.(Mi Casa Su Casa sign on the side of the outside steps are not included in the sale and will be removed before the close)-----
